Weather in June and July across the host cities

By VERIFY_PEN_NAME · Updated 2026-11-22

The tournament falls in the southern hemisphere's winter. In Brazil that means very different conditions from city to city, so pack for the cities you will visit, not for "Brazil".

City by city

CityJune–July in briefPack
Porto AlegreThe coldest host city: cool to cold days, chilly nights, rainy spellsA warm jacket
São PauloMild days, chilly nights, grey drizzly spellsA warm layer
Belo HorizonteDry, sunny, mild days and cool nightsA light jacket
BrasíliaDry season: sunny days, cool nights, very low humiditySunscreen, water, lip balm
Rio de JaneiroMild and often sunny, cooler eveningsA light layer
SalvadorWarm, with regular showersLight rain gear
RecifeWarm, rainy seasonLight rain gear
FortalezaHot with a sea breeze, end of the rainy seasonSun protection, light rain gear

Night matches

Evening kickoffs in the south and south-east can feel cold, especially in Porto Alegre and São Paulo. In the north-east, rain is the bigger concern.
